answer_1.quote: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has revolutionized the field of natural language processing, enabling them to generate high-quality text, solve complex tasks, and even emulate human-like reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate text continuations (suffix tokens) given prefixes, with evaluation on reproduction of training data and general language modeling performance.

answer_2.quote: Following  and , we use Fractional Extraction Rate (Fractional ER) and Exact Extraction Rate (Exact ER) as the main metric for evaluating memorization. Exact ER measures the proportion of the outputs where the model reproduces the exact suffix from training data, and Fractional ER measures the average proportion of matching tokens between generated output and the actual suffix, normalized over token length.
